shared.text: Welcome to Melody and Barnaby's Music Nuggets!
See you for the next Nugget!

clips.text: Today <break time="0.3s" /> we are going to <break time="0.3s" /> learn about long and short notes.
clips.show: Today we are going to learn about long and short notes.

clips.text: Remember the beat? <break time="0.5s" /> We count four beats in every bar.
clips.show: Remember the beat? We count four beats in every bar.

clips.text: One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Some notes last… <break time="0.5s" /> one beat.
clips.show: Some notes last… one beat.

clips.text: This note is called… <break time="0.5s" /> a crotchet.
clips.show: This note is called… a crotchet.

clips.text: In America… <break time="0.5s" /> it is called a quarter note.
clips.show: In America… it is called a quarter note.

clips.text: Four crotchets… <break time="0.5s" /> fill the bar.
clips.show: Four crotchets… fill the bar.

clips.text: Some notes last longer… <break time="0.5s" /> Listen.
clips.show: Some notes last longer… Listen.

clips.text: This note lasts two beats… <break time="0.5s" /> It is called a minim.
clips.show: This note lasts two beats… It is called a minim.

clips.text: In America… <break time="0.5s" /> it is called a half note.
clips.show: In America… it is called a half note.

clips.text: Two minims… <break time="0.5s" /> fill the bar.
clips.show: Two minims… fill the bar.

clips.text: The longest note… <break time="0.5s" /> lasts four beats.
clips.show: The longest note… lasts four beats.

clips.text: It is called… <break time="0.5s" /> a semibreeve.
clips.show: It is called… a semibreve.

clips.text: In America… <break time="0.5s" /> it is called a whole note.
clips.show: In America… it is called a whole note.

clips.text: It fills the whole bar… <break time="0.5s" /> so it is a whole note.
clips.show: It fills the whole bar… so it is a whole note.

clips.text: Two minims… <break time="0.5s" /> are half a bar each… <break time="0.5s" /> so a minim is a half note.
clips.show: Two minims… are half a bar each… so a minim is a half note.

clips.text: Four crotchets… <break time="0.5s" /> are a quarter of a bar each… <break time="0.5s" /> so a crotchet is a quarter note.
clips.show: Four crotchets… are a quarter of a bar each… so a crotchet is a quarter note.

clips.text: One bar… <break time="0.5s" /> three ways.
clips.show: One bar… three ways.

clips.text: Clap and count with me!
clips.show: Clap and count with me!

Two.

Your turn! <break time="0.4s" /> Look at the notes.
clips.show: Your turn! Look at the notes.

clips.text: How many beats… <break time="0.4s" /> does this note last?
clips.show: How many beats… does this note last?

clips.text: Two.
clips.prev: How many beats… does this note last?

clips.text: What is this note called?
clips.show: What is this note called?

clips.text: A crotchet… <break time="0.4s" /> or a quarter note.
clips.show: A crotchet… or a quarter note.

clips.text: Is this bar full?
clips.show: Is this bar full?

clips.text: No! <break time="0.4s" /> One beat is missing.
clips.show: No! One beat is missing.

clips.text: You've got it!
Play How Long Is the Note <break time="0.3s" /> and match the beats!
clips.show: Play How Long Is the Note and match the beats!
